scenes.title: There is no Clarendon application form.
scenes.say: There is no separate application form for Oxford's Clarendon Scholarship.

scenes.title: Apply to your course on time
scenes.body: Apply by your course's December or January funding deadline and you're considered.
scenes.say: Apply to your graduate course by its December or January funding deadline, and you are considered automatically.

scenes.title: What Oxford says it covers
items: A living grant for full-time scholars
scenes.say: Oxford says Clarendon covers course fees in full, with a living grant for full-time scholars, and there are no restrictions by nationality.

scenes.title: Most offers by end of April
scenes.body: No news by mid-June usually means no award.
scenes.say: Most offers go out by the end of April. If you haven't heard by mid-June, Oxford says to assume you weren't awarded.

scenes.title: Check your course's deadline today
scenes.say: Check your course's deadline today. Start for free at tryivyward dot com.
